data.definitions:
- **Source:** OpenStreetMap (`© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0`, extracted offline from Geofabrik `vietnam-latest.osm.pbf`) bus route relations (`network = Xe buýt Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh`) converted to a frequency-based GTFS snapshot, joined to OSM post-July-2025 municipal ward/commune boundaries (`relation/1973756`, 168 subareas). Community open data: **not** an official agency timetable and **not** a live service.
- **400 m walk-shed (M1, % of natural land area, not % of population):** Each active stop is projected from `EPSG:4326` to metric `EPSG:32648` (UTM Zone 48N, `always_xy := true`), buffered by 400 m, and merged with `ST_Union_Agg` before intersecting each ward polygon so overlapping stop circles are never double-counted. The denominator is natural administrative area (including Cần Giờ mangrove forests, rivers, and waterways), so M1 measures **% of land area**, **not** `% of population`. Straight-line (Euclidean) 400 m is also more optimistic than street-network walking distance.
- **Border-adjacent stops:** All active stops of `Xe buýt Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh` are kept in the 400 m buffer union before clipping to each ward polygon, so stops situated immediately outside a pre-merger ward boundary still contribute their 400 m walk-shed into neighboring border wards.
- **Frequent service ≥ 4 buses/h (M2, OSM `interval` only, no arrival times):** Because most HCMC OSM routes tag `interval` as a peak to off-peak range (e.g. `00:10-00:20`), M2 is derived solely from OSM `interval` tags by summing guaranteed minimum hourly departures `3600 / interval_max_s` across distinct serving route-directions (headline: conservative bound ≥ 4 buses/h, ≤ 15 min average wait; sensitivity: midpoint `interval_mid_s`). Because **0 %** of primary HCMC OSM bus relations carry a `duration` tag, derived `stop_times.txt` keeps stop order only; there are **no actual arrival times**, and schedule reliability cannot be measured without official GTFS-Realtime feeds.
- **Two scopes:** `Pre-merger HCMC (102)` selects strictly the 102 commune-level units (78 wards + 24 communes) formed on pre-merger Ho Chi Minh City territory under National Assembly Standing Committee Resolution `1685/NQ-UBTVQH15` (16 Jun 2025, effective 1 Jul 2025; OSM total ~2,058 km² vs official ~2,095 km², −1.8 % coastal/water-boundary difference); `Merged city (168)` covers all 168 post-July-2025 subareas including former Bình Dương (36) and Bà Rịa - Vũng Tàu (30) units served mainly by provincial bus networks outside `Xe buýt Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh`.

hand_checks.assessment: Within published length range (outbound 10.49 km vs inbound 8.30 km due to one-way downtown streets); OSM reflects post-Metro-1 Ba Son terminus; peak bound 8 min vs published 5 min.
hand_checks.corridor: Bến xe Chợ Lớn to Ga Ba Son

hand_checks.assessment: +3.5 to +4.5% longer than published (+1.2 to 1.5 km): OSM maps 5.80 km (outbound, rel/17376396: 34.31 km) and 5.31 km (inbound, rel/17376397: 34.01 km) of internal VNU-HCM (ĐHQG) campus loops and terminal turnaround ways, plus 0.14 km of duplicate ways on outbound. Hours and 4 to 15 min headway match.
hand_checks.corridor: Bến xe Quận 8 to Đại học Quốc gia

hand_checks.assessment: +5% longer than ~28 km published corridor (29.73 km outbound vs 29.03 km inbound) due to internal ĐHQG loop ways; outbound OSM relation had 1 out-of-order way fixed during way-sum computation; OSM interval (8 to 12 min) is narrower than published 6 to 15 min.
hand_checks.corridor: Bến xe Sài Gòn, KCX Linh Trung, ĐH Quốc gia

hand_checks.assessment: +11.3% longer (+3.0 km) than SaigonBus's ~26.5 km figure: outbound rel/17428226 (30.08 km) and inbound rel/17431068 (29.01 km) differ by 1.07 km on one-way approaches and include extended internal ĐHQG Khu A / KTX / Bách khoa CS2 campus loops (5.85 km outbound, 7.03 km inbound) with appended/reordered terminal stops and 0.22 km duplicate outbound ways. Outbound interval (15 to 25 min) matches official; inbound retains stale 10 to 30 min tag. Duration missing on OSM (published ~65 min).
hand_checks.corridor: Đại học Bách khoa to Đại học Quốc gia

hand_checks.assessment: +1.4% length difference (26.71 km outbound vs 27.21 km inbound); OSM tags peak 10 to 15 min band only (omits 15 to 20 min off-peak band), showing OSM headway can slightly overstate off-peak frequency.
hand_checks.corridor: Bến xe Chợ Lớn to Bến xe Miền Đông mới
